items.title: "I would like to invite you and Spider-Man to have dinner at my house"
items.summary: Presenting at the Emmys, SNL's Marcello Hernández told Zendaya, "I saw you and I wanted to play it cool, and I decided I can't do that. So I would like to invite you and Spider-Man to have dinner at my house," as she burst out laughing and turned to her husband, Tom Holland, sitting beside her. The clip got 403K likes.
items.author: @chrislarbsyou
